Composite = weighted blend of the four metrics above (30% Levenshtein similarity, 25% Jaro–Winkler, 20% bigram Dice, 25% phonetic skeleton match), thresholded at ≥0.85 High / ≥0.75 Medium / below Low — the same bands used in the source dataset. This is a client-side re-implementation for interactive checking, not a lookup into the workbook itself, so scores for pairs already in the list below may differ by a few thousandths from the original.

On "POCA score": this dataset's source workbook (TPU_tradename_LASA_candidate_pairs.xlsx) doesn't contain a metric by that name — the scored fields are Levenshtein, Jaro–Winkler, bigram/trigram Dice & Jaccard, phonetic match, and the Composite LASA Score shown above. If POCA refers to a specific scale you use internally (e.g. a local P&T/pharmacy confusability rubric), tell me its formula or thresholds and I can add it as a column here.
